Opens «و سئل عليه السلام» with the Imam unnamed and no previous report supplied in the context, so no name can be taken; groups is empty (the Imam is not guessed).

«وَ سُئِلَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ» has no transmitter and no name for the asker or for the Imam, the same shape as «قضى أمير المؤمنين ... في» with no transmitter (rule 11). The context gives no previous report, so nothing is inherited and no groups are written.
